title: Emergence of Isotropic Big-Bang Singularities
exact_target: Explain mathematically why general cosmological data could produce a homogeneous isotropic initial singularity with vanishing Weyl curvature.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30004801 (OWR-8415343-003). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mathematical Aspects of General Relativity (2021), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2021/40, pp. 2157--2267. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 26, 27.
Borde--Guth--Vilenkin, inflationary incompleteness (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: This is a cosmological mechanism question rather than one fully specified theorem. The matter equations, admissible data, singularity limit and meaning of emergence are not fixed by the extraction; a uniqueness account of the universe\textquotesingle s origin is not inferred.
